steps.name: Inam
steps.text: I'll leave Acahualla and the Durins from Zeruertza to you guys.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Inam, you sure you have to go?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Don't go!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Don't be silly. I have to go.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: *whimper*... Inam... I'll miss you...

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: What's with you two? You're making it sound like I'm never coming back!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: But you said you'll be gone for a long time...

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: This lord ameer candidacy is even more of a mess than that whole ruckus with the Big, Ugly Thing Zumama caused. Of course I can't promise to be back tomorrow!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: *whimpers*...

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: *sigh*

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: More and more, I'm thinking I made the right choice to become the lord ameer myself.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Anyway, Gavial, I'm counting on you to lead the Acahualla and the Zeruertza Durins while I'm gone.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: What do you need me to do, exactly?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Nothing.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You mean, keep the status quo?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: This is how Acahualla's always been. As for the Durins, they've been in a hurry to build their settlement. To the point they even voted to prohibit alcohol to improve efficiency.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Prohibit alcohol? The Durins?!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Right, I was surprised too.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: But that's what they decided on. Looks like they have a sense of urgency, too.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: And going by their speed, they'll probably be finished by the time I get back.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Your job is to make sure everything stays the same, as if I never left. That's very important to everyone here.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I get it. The Durins' settlement comes first, right?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You can count on me!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: (Doubtful glare)

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: By the way, I hid the Durins' brewing equipment in... (whispers).

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Do not let them find it. Understand?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Whoa, that's some hiding spot.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Huh? Where did she hide it? I wanna know!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: You've seen how crazy the Durins get whenever alcohol's involved. If I told you, it wouldn't take them long to squeeze that information out of you.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: *whimpers*...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: But in that case, wouldn't it be better to keep me out of this too?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: ...I'm leaving to rub shoulders with those guys from the Court of Sargon, after all. I have to be prepared for anything.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: If it turns out it'll be a while till I get back, the Durins will have to forgo their taste of home for just as long. And I wouldn't want to be the one to blame.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Alright, now let me go over the other things you need to keep an eye out for...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Is this really okay, Gavial?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hm? We're just helping the Durins look for some suitable timber. What's not okay about it?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: But Inam told us not to do anything...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh, I was wondering what you were going to say.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: What she meant was we aren't supposed to change the rules she set, not that we shouldn't do anything.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Besides, did you see how the Durins were at it under the blazing sun? I'd feel bad not helping them out somehow—

steps.name: Astute Durin
steps.text: Gavial, is that you?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Are you a Zeruertza Durin?

steps.name: Astute Durin
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: You lost like Stitch was before? How about I walk you back?

steps.name: Astute Durin
steps.text: No need.

steps.name: Astute Durin
steps.text: I'm here because I have something to talk to you about.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Whatever it is, let's talk after we get back. This rainforest isn't all that safe.

steps.name: Astute Durin
steps.text: No, no, no. There's nowhere safer than here.

steps.name: Astute Durin
steps.text: You see, I'm from the mead fan club...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: So it's about the prohibition, huh?

steps.name: Astute Durin
steps.text: It's a good thing you're such a reasonable woman—

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hold on, no dice.

steps.name: Astute Durin
steps.text: No room for negotiation at all?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You guys are the ones who voted to forbid all alcohol. You got a problem with that, talk to your own people.

steps.name: Astute Durin
steps.text: But Inam kept all our equipment.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Uh, she never told me where she stored it—

steps.name: Astute Durin
steps.text: Really? Only she knows?

steps.name: Astute Durin
steps.text: How could she do that? What if she forgets where she hid it? We'll never again get to taste Zeruertza's fine mead again. How irresponsible of her...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: She's not irresponsible at all! She told Gavial where she kept the mead brewing equipment!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh my lord.

steps.name: Astute Durin
steps.text: Hah, I knew it. There's no way Inam wouldn't leave a back-up plan.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Yeah, yeah—

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Ow!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Not like I'll ever tell you guys.

steps.name: Astute Durin
steps.text: Alright, fine, looks like we won't get our mead today.

steps.name: Astute Durin
steps.text: But we'll never give up!

steps.name: Astute Durin
steps.text: Just as a city is laid brick by brick, I'll taste the whereabouts of our brewing equipment, bit by bit!

spans.text: Just as a city is laid brick by brick, I'll
the whereabouts of our brewing equipment, bit by bit!

steps.name: Clear-headed Durin
steps.text: Good afternoon, Gavial.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Heyas, what's up?

steps.name: Clear-headed Durin
steps.text: We have a bit of an urgent matter on our hands, so I have no choice but to visit you here.

steps.name: Clear-headed Durin
steps.text: We're lacking some... necessities, and my fellows are all... fairly low in spirits. They're tormented, unable to sleep, and in pain.

spans.text: We're lacking some... necessities, and my fellows are all... fairly low in
. They're tormented, unable to sleep, and in pain.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Poor fellas...

steps.name: Clear-headed Durin
steps.text: I want to soothe their pain, which is why I've come to request your help, our most respected Gavial.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: We should help them, Gavial!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: First off, don't you stick some weird adjective in front of my name.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Secondly, the necessities you guys are out of have gotta be mead, right?

steps.name: Clear-headed Durin
steps.text: What a load of rubbish!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Clear-headed Durin
steps.text: How could you possibly compare that kids' drink to our noble No. 7 Whiskey?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Well, whatever it is, you guys ain't getting a sip, so why does it matter?

steps.name: Clear-headed Durin
steps.text: Oh, cruel Gavial. How could you be so merciless?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Before you accuse me of being merciless, can't you do something about the way you talk? It's weird.

steps.name: Clear-headed Durin
steps.text: Huh? Is it weird?

steps.name: Clear-headed Durin
steps.text: And here I thought it would be easier to talk to surface-dwellers if I imitated Avdotya's characters.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Yeah, no, it doesn't work that way. Talk normal.

steps.name: Clear-headed Durin
steps.text: I'll die if I don't get any whiskey!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Bear with it!

steps.name: Courteous Durin
steps.text: Gavial, would you please tell us where Inam hid the brewing tools?

steps.name: Stubborn Durin
steps.text: Gavial, where did she hide our distilling equipment?

steps.name: Chatty Durin
steps.text: Gavial, our brewing equipment...

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Hey, Gavial.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Zumama? Good to see you. Finally, someone who'll talk about something other than alcohol.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: (Freezes)

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Urgh...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I have a bad feeling about this.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: (Deep breath)

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: It's about the Durins' brewing and distilling equipment...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Why are you of all people asking about that?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: They promised me that the moment they get their equipment back, they'll send their mechanics to help me test my robots with their technology.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Give it up.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Nnuuh...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: That said, I really didn't expect you on their side.

spans.text: That said, I really didn't expect

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Who else have they talked to?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Let's see...

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: They tried Tomimi, but they got blasted out.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: They've also talked to their Great Chief Edge Eartheart and others from Zeruertza.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: They said it themselves. Aside from Avdotya, everyone's been either somewhat lax about it or at least... ambiguous.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Ambiguous?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Supposedly, they've even managed to persuade Chief Edge despite how strict he was with the ban at first. And we've both seen in Zeruertza how the alcohol there flew right off the shelves.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: This can't continue!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: We can't waste any more time with these fellas. They're the ones who banned all the booze, so of course they can unban it, too.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: But if it comes to that, they'll never finish their settlement... I don't want Acahualla to have nothing but a bunch of incomplete buildings waiting for Inam when she gets back!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: ...Wow.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You wouldn't want to see that either, right?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: It doesn't really matter to me, but... I'll follow your lead.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Bring Tomimi here. Time for a war council.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Huh???

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: What do we do, Gavial?!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Calm down, Tomimi.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I'll go talk to Master Edge and ask him not to change his mind!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Stop. Stop! Come back!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I just talked to Gavial. It's not like Edge doesn't drink himself. It probably wouldn't be a good idea to talk to him now.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Avdotya might just be the only one who'll follow through with the ban, but since this involves the Durins' immediate benefit, she might be powerless herself.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: *whine*...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Actually, I have an idea.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Really? I knew you'd know what to do!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Don't get ahead of yourself. I can't do this on my own. I need your help.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Tomimi, send the word out to all the tribes and ask them to keep an eye on the Durins.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Huh? What are they gonna do?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: That depends on Zumama and her mission...

steps.name: Clear-headed Durin
steps.text: How many days has it been since we last had a sip?

steps.name: Astute Durin
steps.text: Yeah, I haven't been keeping count, you whiskey idiot. Couldn't be bothered to. All I remember is that all the men you guys sent to persuade her came back empty-handed. You guys are even more pathetic than Originium slugs.

steps.name: Clear-headed Durin
steps.text: What did you just say, you mead wimp?!

steps.name: Astute Durin
steps.text: ...Let me warn you. You can insult us, but you can't insult Old Karl Mead!

steps.name: Astute Durin
steps.text: The way I see it, you guys got brain damage from all that stinking foot odor you guys got with your whiskey!

steps.name: Courteous Durin
steps.text: You know...

steps.name: Astute Durin
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Courteous Durin
steps.text: I've always advocated for both sides to peacefully coexist.

steps.name: Clear-headed Durin
steps.text: Get to the point, you berry tomato wine freak.

steps.name: Courteous Durin
steps.text: Actually, my guys have almost persuaded Master Edge. We just need to wait a couple more days. Just a few more days—

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hey there, my conspirators. Nice to see you guys.

steps.name: Booze-loving Durins
steps.text: Gavial?!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I'm here to talk conditions.

steps.name: Clear-headed Durin
steps.text: What conditions?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I know you guys want your booze making tools, and you can't wait to get your hands on them, right?

steps.name: Astute Durin
steps.text: True enough.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I'll give you guys a way out, then.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: If you guys manage to beat me, I'll give you your tools back.

steps.name: Astute Durin
steps.text: Really? Get her, boys—

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Just like that?

steps.name: Astute Durin
steps.text: Uhh... I guess we'll need to make some preparations first.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Good call.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I'll say this again. If one of you manages to defeat me, I'll give that person the tools back.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hey, you there. That's right. You.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: An ambush isn't gonna work on me.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Anyone who tries might just end up having to give up drinking for the rest of their life.

steps.name: Clear-headed Durin
steps.text: Eek!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Besides, ambushes are kinda underhanded, wouldn't you agree?

steps.name: Courteous Durin
steps.text: W-We aren't going to bow down to you!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Good, you've got some backbone. I'd expect no less from the newest residents of Acahualla.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Now hurry up with your preparations. I'm ready when you are!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Zumama, how are things going on your end?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: At first, they thought they could take you on just by working a little harder and putting some gear together. Clearly they underestimated you.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: But after you handed their asses to them every single time, they started looking for another way, and it didn't take much work for me to divert their attention to robotics.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I lent them the blueprints for the Big, Ugly Thing and had a bit of a technological exchange with them. I have to say, the Durins' technology is really interesting.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Their self-driving carts may act like they might as well be blind, but the technology behind them is nothing to scoff at. Once deployed, we'll be in for quite a show.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: That's not a bad thing... but what I'm worried about is them putting together a self-driving Big, Ugly Thing.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I think that's exactly what they have in mind.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: (Shrugs)

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Alright, fine. We were going to take this chance to see if the Durins would put together some kind of machine they could use in construction anyway.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: And I mean, they haven't really been putting up much of a fight the last few days. Getting to fight something like the Big, Ugly Thing again isn't so bad.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Bad news, Gavial!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh? What's the matter? Did the Durins start fighting among themselves over their booze?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Yeah, the mead fan club almost had an all-out brawl with the No. 7 Whiskey fans—

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: No, that's not what I'm here about!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: They put together a robot just as awesome as the Big, Ugly Thing, and they're testing out its weapons right now!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: That's exactly what Zumama's mission was. Don't you remember?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Oh... I guess I worried too much.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Alright, I'll keep watching them test their weapons, then! It's like, kaboom! It looks really amazing!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Alright. Let me know if something seems off—

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hold up, where are they doing this testing?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: At a cave not far north of the Eunectes tribe. There's nothing but trees there.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: A cave north of... the Eunectes tribe—

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Dammit!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Tomimi, hurry up and stop them. Zumama and I will be there soon!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: They're just testing weapons. Why are you so worried about it all of a sudden?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: That's the cave where Inam hid all their alcohol making equipment!

steps.name: Not Very Clear-headed Durin
steps.text: Hah—*yawn*.

steps.name: Not Very Astute Durin
steps.text: G-Gavial?!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hey, fellas. Mind testing your weapons somewhere else?

steps.name: Not Very Clear-headed Durin
steps.text: Why should we?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Not Very Clear-headed Durin
steps.text: You're the one who told us you'll give us back our tools if we defeat you!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: That I did say.

steps.name: Not Very Astute Durin
steps.text: Then why are you trying to stop us?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Well—That's not what I'm here for. I just want you guys to go someplace else to test your... your...

steps.name: Not Very Courteous Durin
steps.text: Giant, Ultimate Ugly Thing Mk. 3!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Right. I just wanted you guys to test out the Giant, Ultimate Ugly Thing Mk. 3 somewhere else, that's all.

steps.name: Not Very Clear-headed Durin
steps.text: This is the most suitable place we found.

steps.name: Not Very Clear-headed Durin
steps.text: Besides, we've already paid such a heavy price just to defeat you!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: What price?

steps.name: Not Very Clear-headed Durin
steps.text: We've toiled through three whole days and nights, but that's not even important.

steps.name: Not Very Clear-headed Durin
steps.text: What's important is we're reduced to working with these mead wimps!

steps.name: Not Very Astute Durin
steps.text: That's right! We're even working with these whiskey idiots!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh... so that's the most important part, huh?

steps.name: Not Very Astute Durin
steps.text: Anyway, we've already sacrificed so much. There's no way we're going to give up just because of what you said!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: All I'm asking is for you to find someplace else.

steps.name: Not Very Astute Durin
steps.text: No means no!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Why's that?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (Whispers) You can't blame them, Gavial.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (Whispers) Avdotya asked them to find somewhere they wouldn't bother anyone. She even threatened to not write ads for their drinks anymore if they disturbed anyone.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (Whispers) That's how they ended up here.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (Whispers) And I saw lots of equipment and machinery already mounted in place. They can't take them away anymore.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: (Whispers) What a headache...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (Whispers) How about I ask them not to hit the cave when they test fire their weapons...?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: That's basically giving it away that there's something there!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: *whine*...

steps.name: Not Very Courteous Durin
steps.text: Now, please leave. Stop bothering us here!

steps.name: Not Very Courteous Durin
steps.text: Or are you trying to interfere because you think you're no match for the Giant, Ultimate Ugly Thing Mk. 3?!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Now that, I can't pretend I didn't hear.

spans.text: , I can't pretend I didn't hear.

steps.name: Not Very Courteous Durin
steps.text: A-Anyway, just leave already!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I'll say this again. I'm asking you guys to move somewhere else for your own benefit.

steps.name: Not Very Courteous Durin
steps.text: We aren't going anywhere!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Ugh—What a pain.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: How about this. We'll fight here and now. How's that?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (Whispers) What are you thinking?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: (Whispers) Instead of letting them stay and blow up the cave, I might as well take the situation into my own hands. Don't worry.

steps.name: Not Very Courteous Durin
steps.text: But we haven't properly tuned our weapons yet...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: If I lose, I'll give you all your tools back. If I win, you guys still get to fight me again later. You've got nothing to lose.

steps.name: Not Very Courteous Durin
steps.text: I... I suppose?
Gavial quickly runs to the south of the enormous machine.

steps.name: Not Very Courteous Durin
steps.text: Hey, why did you come over here?!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: That's a cave and a cliff over there. I gotta give myself some room, right?

steps.name: Not Very Courteous Durin
steps.text: Alright, makes sense.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: How about we get started, then?

steps.name: Not Very Courteous Durin
steps.text: W-We aren't gonna hold back!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Well, that thing sure packs some firepower. I can barely get any closer.

steps.name: Not Very Courteous Durin
steps.text: That's not all! Durin Tree Trunk Saw, activate!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hell yeah!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: But not enough!

steps.name: Not Very Courteous Durin
steps.text: What?! She stopped the maximum turbo engine all by herself?!

steps.name: Not Very Courteous Durin
steps.text: Shit! Parry! Parry immediately!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: They dodged it?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: That's quite an agile design. You ever thought about using that to build your settlement?

steps.name: Not Very Courteous Durin
steps.text: Let's hear you say that after this!

steps.name: Not Very Courteous Durin
steps.text: Take this!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Ohh!

steps.name: Not Very Courteous Durin
steps.text: She blocked an artillery shell with her axe?!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Zumama forged this for me. A couple of artillery shells? Piece of cake.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Now it's my turn!

steps.name: Not Very Courteous Durin
steps.text: Crap! Fall back! Fall back right now!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Not happening! Here comes the saw!

steps.name: Not Very Clear-headed Durin
steps.text: Why are we falling back? We should be parrying to the side!

steps.name: Not Very Astute Durin
steps.text: No, we should push forward. That's the only way we can dodge her saw's attacks!

steps.name: Not Very Courteous Durin
steps.text: Stop! Stop trying to take the controller—

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: What a strange movement pattern... Why did it get behind me?!

steps.name: Not Very Courteous Durin
steps.text: Settle down, you two! We almost lost right there!

steps.name: Not Very Courteous Durin
steps.text: You have nowhere to run, Gavial! Take my ultimate attack—

steps.name: Not Very Courteous Durin
steps.text: Durin Out-of-Control Guided Missiles Omnidirectional Bombardment!!!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Crap! The cave!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Why an omnidirectional bombardment, now of all times?!
Gavial takes a deep breath, relaxes her tail, and drops her saw on the ground.
She grips the large axe with both hands.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Haah!

steps.name: Not Very Clear-headed Durin
steps.text: What?! H-How high did she jump?!
Gavial leaps into the air and hops onto gigantic machine's leg, then its chest.
With the robot's surface as a stepping stone, Gavial once again springs up and curls her tail around its raised robotic arm, swinging towards the cave's entrance on the other side.
*Brrrr*–
Gavial looks at the artillery shells all over the ground and raises the giant axe in her hand.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hah... hah...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Good thing that was omnidirectional, and none of them headed this way...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: And I also gotta thank you guys for not putting any explosives in the missiles... At least you knew to hold back there...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: *belch*

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Not Very Courteous Durin
steps.text: I have no idea why you care about that cave so much, but now that you've had a taste of our missiles, there's no way you can stand anymore!

steps.name: Not Very Courteous Durin
steps.text: The missiles are filled with Archosaurian booze. Even those with the highest tolerance amongst us can't stay on their feet after getting blasted by one of these!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Urgh...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: So... Does it look like I'm lying on the ground right now?

steps.name: Not Very Courteous Durin
steps.text: No way...

steps.name: Not Very Courteous Durin
steps.text: How come the missile didn't work on you?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I mean, how much booze did you put in the missiles anyway? It's not like I drank any. Breathing in that little bit just makes you tipsy at most. Why would anyone fall down and not be able to get up?

steps.name: Not Very Courteous Durin
steps.text: But none of us could...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: That just goes to show what a bunch of lightweights you guys are.

steps.name: Not Very Courteous Durin
steps.text: (Facepalms)

steps.name: Not Very Courteous Durin
steps.text: Set that aside for now! Why are you so worried about the cave, Gavial?! Are you hiding something in there that's stopping us from getting our tools back?!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Whatever, now that it's come to this. I'll tell you.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Inam hid all your tools inside.

steps.name: Booze-loving Durins
steps.text: What???

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: If you don't believe me, go check it out yourself. Of course, until you defeat me, I'm not going to let you take them.

steps.name: Starting-to-be-Courteous Durin
steps.text: So... That's why you leapt up there? To keep our tools from getting hit by the missiles?

steps.name: Starting-to-be-Astute Durin
steps.text: So that's why you ran behind the Giant, Ultimate Ugly Thing Mk. 3? Because you were scared of the cave getting caught in the battle?

steps.name: Starting-to-be-Clear-headed Durin
steps.text: That's why you tried to chase us away? Because you were afraid our tools would be caught in the weapons test?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Didn't I tell you? I asked you guys to go somewhere else for your own benefit.

steps.name: Courteous Durin
steps.text: Gavial... Your tail looks like it's bleeding.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: It's no big deal.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I use my tail to pull myself up the machine. Maybe something sharp gave me a cut or something.

steps.name: Astute Durin
steps.text: Your face is hurt, too.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: It's been a while since I've had such a great fight. Would be weird to not be hurt somewhere.

steps.name: Clear-headed Durin
steps.text: Do you want to keep going...?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Up to you.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: If you guys are up to it, I'm all for it.

steps.name: Courteous Durin
steps.text: Maybe... in a few days.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Yeah, that's probably for the better. I mean, your ultimate attacks didn't seem to work on me at all.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Of course, I'll post guards here to keep a close eye on the cave. Don't you even think about getting your stuff back without defeating me!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You guys are here.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh, looks like you brought your Giant, Ultimate Ugly Thing Mk. 3 too.

steps.name: Courteous Durin
steps.text: This is the Mk. 4.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Good. Looks like technology evolves fast.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Should we get started, then?

steps.name: Courteous Durin
steps.text: Hold on.
Holding the remote controller in his hand, the Durin looks at neither Gavial nor the large robot. Instead, he looks to the sky and starts mumbling.

steps.name: Courteous Durin
steps.text: If Gavial does this, then I'll...

steps.name: Courteous Durin
steps.text: I do this, and Gavial will...

steps.name: Courteous Durin
steps.text: Gavial does that, I'll—

steps.name: Courteous Durin
steps.text: I'll...
The Durin freezes for a moment before drooping his head.

steps.name: Courteous Durin
steps.text: Should we get started now?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Alright, let's do this!
Gavial assumes her stance and waits for the giant machine's attack.
At that very moment, the Durin presses down on the remote in his hand.
A large explosion occurs, but Gavial finds herself unscathed.
She gapes at the robot, now nothing but a pile of scrap metal.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Wha... What the hell is this about?

steps.name: Courteous Durin
steps.text: We made lots of improvements after the last battle, but our careful tests show that the Giant, Ultimate Ugly Thing series is no match for you even after all our upgrades.

steps.name: Courteous Durin
steps.text: That's why I came up with one last trick: have the Giant, Ultimate Ugly Thing Mk. 4 blow itself up.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: But you didn't have to self-destruct the minute we start, right?

steps.name: Courteous Durin
steps.text: ...I did that because I was working out what you'd do.

steps.name: Courteous Durin
steps.text: And I figured that we were never going to win even if with the self-destruct.

steps.name: Courteous Durin
steps.text: It's to show that we're accepting our defeat. I had no other choice!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: But I was waiting for Zumama to turn it into an industrial robot!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Welcome back, Inam.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Welcome back!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: You two look quite cheerful.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: You came back quick. I bet everything must have gone really well!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Couldn't have been better. Thanks to the preparations we made beforehand, the Court of Sargon was absolutely not interested in Acahualla.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: So how were things here? Everything running as usual?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Yup, super normal! Gavial's keeping the Durins' alcohol ban going just fine!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Sounds like you've done well, Gavial.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: So how did it feel like, having to deal with the Durins?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Pretty good.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: They may look like a stubborn bunch that likes to fool around, but they actually aren't so bad.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: How did you stop the ones that keep clamoring for booze, then?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Mostly with my fists.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: You beat them up?!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Gavial didn't do that! They made a promise. Anyone who manages to defeat Gavial gets their tools back, but none of them ever won!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Oh, so that's how it was.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: ...Isn't that kind of the same thing as beating them up?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Why don't we head back first?

steps.name: Clear-headed Durin
steps.text: Inam, you're back!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Hello.

steps.name: Clear-headed Durin
steps.text: Come, take a look at this! This is a list of events in our competition.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: A competition...?

steps.name: Clear-headed Durin
steps.text: That's right! A competition!

steps.name: Clear-headed Durin
steps.text: I still have a business meeting with my buddies at the mead fan club, so I'll get going now. See you later!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: The Third... Giant, Ultimate Ugly Thing Cup... Self-Driving Robots Competition Preliminaries...

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: The victor's creation will fight against Gavial... and defeating Gavial will result in the return of all alcohol making tools and equipment...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Inam, you don't look too well. Got a headache or something?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: To tell the truth, yes.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Never mind, I more or less expected something like this with Gavial in charge.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Let's head to the Durins' settlement. If they're having so much fun, surely they must already be done with all the construction?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Hey, isn't that Zeruertza's weather forecast chief? Is he joining in on this?

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: Like I said, Avdotya, I've already made it to the semifinals. I just need one more round! One more round!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Inam? Is that you?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Finally, you are back! Please, help me talk some sense into Chief Edge. Ask him to get everyone to stop all this self-driving robot nonsense!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Gavial?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Uh, something the matter?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Don't tell me you came up with these competitions to keep the Durins from drinking.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Er... More or less?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Then what about the Durins' settlement?!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Look.
A gigantic machine pulls into the area.
A few Durins, keeping a safe distance from the robot, pilot it remotely as it passes by the two of them.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: What's this abomination that looks like the bastard child of the Big, Ugly Thing and their self-drivers...?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: If memory serves, they call it the 'Giant, Ultimate Ugly Thing Mk. 5.'

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: It's no match for me, but thanks to Zumama and Deculture Silvermint, it makes for a passable industrial robot.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: If only your trip took a couple more days. We could've finished the settlement before you got back!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: I must be dreaming.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Gavial, punch me.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Ow!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: This is real?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Gavial! Gavial!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: What's up?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: The preliminaries' winner has been decided, and the Durins are clamoring for you to fight their champion!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: So, Inam, it's been a while since Acahualla last had a duel. Wanna come watch?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: My pleasure.
